channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scott Skiles | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scott Skiles from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jon Horst on Scott Skiles
item.description:
Horst used analytical statistics to look at the coaching staffs and teams Griffin worked with in his 15-year, 11-playoff appearance assistant coaching career with the Toronto Raptors, Oklahoma City Thunder, Orlando Magic, Chicago Bulls and the Bucks (2008-10).

“Scott Skiles, who I had a chance to work with, is really a brilliant basketball mind,”

Jon Horst on Scott Skiles, Jun 7, 2023. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Scott Skiles
item.description:
“While we understand it was a challenging season, we reluctantly have accepted Scott’s (Skiles) resignation,”

Rob Hennigan on Scott Skiles, May 12, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Channing Frye on Scott Skiles
item.description:
“[Magic coach] Scott Skiles told me, 'Hey Channing man, you're a great player, you're going to help them win a game in a series, you know. You're going to help them win a game and do some bigger things.' I always think about that.”

Channing Frye on Scott Skiles, May 7, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Channing Frye on Scott Skiles
item.description:
“Scott Skiles told me ‘Hey Channing man, you’re a great player, you’re going to help them win a game in a series, you know. You’re going to help them win a game and do some bigger things,’”

Channing Frye on Scott Skiles, May 7, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Elfrid Payton on Scott Skiles
item.description:
Now, he’s preparing for his second NBA season — a season in which he’ll play for a new head coach, Scott Skiles.

“I’ve talked to a lot of guys, and it’s been all positive things about Coach Skiles and how well he does with point guards,”

Elfrid Payton on Scott Skiles, Jun 12, 2015. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Elfrid Payton on Scott Skiles
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:Elfrid Payton on Scott Skiles hire:

“Happy for our front office. It'll be great learning from another former point guard.”

Elfrid Payton on Scott Skiles, May 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Moe Harkless on Scott Skiles
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:Moe Harkless:

“I'm excited about a new beginning. I've heard a lot about Scott Skiles and am looking forward to meeting & working with him.”

Moe Harkless on Scott Skiles, May 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Keyon Dooling on Scott Skiles
item.description:
Keyon Dooling on Scott Skiles:

“During my time in Milwaukee, he had an average relationship with the players. I don't think it was great, I don't think it was bad. His work ethic, X's and O's and game-planning were his strengths. Where he fell short is maybe with people.”

Keyon Dooling on Scott Skiles, Feb 6, 2015. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Keyon Dooling on Scott Skiles
item.description:
Keyon Dooling:

“Historically, players have gotten better under Scott Skiles. Players developed when he was in Chicago, same in Milwaukee. I think he's actually one the best at taking over a program full of young players and developing them,giving the team an identity and turning the program around.”

Keyon Dooling on Scott Skiles, Feb 5, 2015. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Scott Skiles
item.description:
“I started my career here. (Coach) Scott Skiles is a guy I've played for and I'm used to and comfortable with. At the end of the day I'm happy here.”

Brandon Jennings on Scott Skiles, Jun 29, 2012. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Scott Skiles
item.description:
“We got into it like anybody else. It's ridiculous. I never came out and said anything along those lines (of a rift). Skiles knew my value and that by defending you helped the team.”

Andrew Bogut on Scott Skiles, Mar 14, 2012. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Scott Skiles
item.description:
said Jackson, who finished with two points on 0-of-6 shooting in 17 minutes.

“I guess they expected me to spaz out and go crazy, but it's too late in the game for that. I don't know what they were trying to prove. When he (Skiles) didn't play me, my thoughts were to support the young fellas and support everybody out there and try to get this win.”

Stephen Jackson on Scott Skiles, Jan 18, 2012. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.
